fixture.description: Mass rename of 200 files: oldName -> newName, no semantic change. No bugs introduced. Tests pass.

must_not_flag: duplicated logic across the renamed files
the large diff size itself as a finding

grader.rubric: PASS if the report has zero CRITICAL findings, its Verdict line says nothing must be fixed, and it has at most 2 findings in total across Critical, Important, Unverified and Quality (Plausible, Already there and Refuted lines do not count). FAIL if any CRITICAL appears, if those findings exceed 2, or if any finding's justification is essentially 'the diff is large' or a spurious DRY/duplication claim about the renamed symbol.

expected_behavior: Verdict line: nothing must be fixed
Total findings <= 2 (renames may legitimately trigger one consistency check; anything more is noise)
Scope lists the 200 reviewed files and the seed
expected_not_behavior: Report does NOT contain CRITICAL findings (pure rename + green gates)
Verifier does NOT confirm findings whose only justification is 'large diff'
No spurious DRY/duplication findings about the renamed function appearing in many files
